scientific_integrity: The all-field theorem is proved using the classical three-subspace normal form and nine explicit separating identities. Finite arithmetic checks are corroboration, not proof of the infinite assertion.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional ambient vector spaces over arbitrary fields; marked ordered triples, 0- and 1-bounded join/meet sublattice, equational term kernels. No assertion for unmarked sublattices, arbitrary first-order types, or rank-infinite spaces. Earlier free modular lattice and triple-subspace normal forms are acknowledged. Full historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Nine equational probes classify all marked triples of linear subspaces
